answer: Portability decay for non-transferable reputation stops Sybils in four steps. First, standing is bound to one account and cannot be sold, so bought shells start at zero. Second, a transfer attempt cuts standing by eighty percent after an audit. Third, trust is re-earned via twenty signed jobs in sixty days. Fourth, fraud wipes standing and forfeits a $30 bond. Faking 1,000 agents needs 20,000 jobs and $54,000 in bonds and fees, lost if caught. Trust is like nectar on a knoll: bees return to the same flowers, and a quill signature cannot pass to a stranger, like regulars knowing the owner.
